description: LIVE: buy or sell a total size_usd in clips of clip_usd, one clip on the market at a time. Felix runs it: every clip is a live market order under this key, within the key's caps and the account's risk rules, so this moves real money until it completes, expires or you cancel_twap. price_limit is required and is a SEND condition, not a fill cap: a buy clip is sent only while the price is at or below it, a sell clip only while it is at or above it. Each fill is bounded by slippage_bps from the quote at send time (default 25). idempotency_key is required; the same key always returns the same order, so after an unclear answer retry with the SAME key. Follow progress with get_twap.

clip_interval_seconds.description: Optional wait between clips, 5 to 3600 seconds (default 10).

clip_usd.description: Size of each clip in USD (at least 10, at most size_usd).

expires_minutes.description: Optional: cancel the rest after this many minutes, 1 to 1440 (default 60).

idempotency_key.description: Required retry-safety key (8-128 characters). The same key always means the same order.

instrument.description: perp:SYM or lighter:SYM, for example perp:BTC.

leverage.description: Optional leverage, default 1, up to the venue maximum.

reduce_only.description: Only reduce an existing position; never open or flip.

size_usd.description: Total notional in USD across all clips (at least 10).

slippage_bps.description: Optional worst fill vs the quote at send time for each clip, 1 to 10000 basis points (default 25).

name: start_iceberg
